summary: Opt-in: every change states its scope, its applicability to each catalogued requirement, its tests and its evidence, with source digests, so a stale record and an uncovered path are caught by a machine. `check` holds every record (FF-CHANGE-RECORDS); `review --base --head` holds a review range covered by VERIFIED records, on a clean checkout of its head -- the CI gate. Tri-state: runtime conformance and production readiness are NOT ASSERTED.
